presets.name: Research
presets.description: Milestone 6: the F4 key with five ranks -- L, M−, M, M+, H -- opened by the 14 registers, a reed for each way the bellows moves (CC 80), one bellows the arm pushes, which gives way as more reeds draw air, and a cassotto for L and M (off by default). The M reed is the F4 the IfM Zwota measured. Every other key is silent.
